Resource measurements use the package versions and source SHA-256 hashes recorded for each cell in method_costs.tsv. Each cell has three independent fitting sessions and separate sessions for model loading. The first 20 held-out specimens are scored individually after one warm-up call. The benchmark split uses seed 101 and grouped fold 1. No clinical performance estimate is calculated from this timing subset.

Fit wall time includes deployment fitting, training-derived score direction and preflight. Registered fitting time is also reported separately. Scoring times are in seconds; the table reports medians and type-7 95th percentiles across calls and repeats. CUDA operations are synchronized at measurement boundaries. Score agreement uses an absolute tolerance of 1e-5 and fitted-state fingerprints are checked before and after scoring.

Peak resident memory is in bytes and includes the R and Python process tree, sampled every 50 ms. Frozen model sizes are uncompressed RDS plus cloudpickle bytes; external checkpoint sizes are separate. Model loading includes Python setup when required by the recorded dependency route. Session wall time includes startup and validation and is distinct from object loading time. Numerical libraries use four threads. CPU model, GPU device, sample count, feature count, repetition count, package version and settings are recorded per cell in method_costs.tsv. Input refusals and unavailable measurements retain their outcome and are not represented as zero time.
